subject: Portal Access & Evidence Triage — OneTrust onboarding for GreenLeaf Labs
messages:
From: Maria Silva <maria.silva@greenleaflabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@greenleaflabs.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: OneTrust onboarding for procurement — initial access

Hi Karthik,

GreenLeaf's procurement team is running a tightened vendor review this week and requested we complete OneTrust profile onboarding and share a handful of supporting artifacts by next Friday (4/30). We wanted to get you looped in to coordinate a short evidence triage and portal invitation.

Priority asks from procurement/security:
- SOC 2 Type II (or summary) proof-of-possession
- Completed CAIQ or SIG-lite Q&A
- SSO/SAML metadata for identity proofing
- Data retention & deletion policy (customer data)

Are you able to accept a portal invite today? If it helps, procurement provided a OneTrust portal link and the contact on their side is me (Maria Silva). We can also accept a partial bundle and follow up with additional items.

Thanks — Maria
Maria Silva
Sr. Security & Vendor Risk Manager
GreenLeaf Labs

--
Attachment: procurement_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Silva <maria.silva@greenleaflabs.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding for procurement — initial access

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads up. We can take ownership of the OneTrust upload and prioritize the items you've listed.

Plan / owners:
- SOC 2 summary and proof-of-possession (I will attach the signed summary and pointer to the full report) — owner: Karthik
- CAIQ / SIG-lite Q&A (we'll do a focused CAIQ for the scope you need) — owner: Mina Haddad
- SSO / SAML metadata (saml-metadata.xml) — owner: Marissa (cc'd)
- Data retention and deletion policy (short memo) — owner: Mina

Immediate ask for you: please share the OneTrust portal invite link and the portal ID so we can accept and start uploading. If GreenLeaf requires evidence as links rather than uploads, we can provide both.

We should be able to get a first-pass bundle into the portal by EOD Friday 4/24; we'll follow with any outstanding artifacts by 4/30. If procurement needs a quicker turnaround, let me know which item to prioritize.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (pdf stub, will upload to portal)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Maria Silva <maria.silva@greenleaflabs.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 15:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding for procurement — initial access

On Fri, Apr 22, 2027 at 10:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Plan / owners:
> - SOC 2 summary and proof-of-possession (I will attach the signed summary and pointer to the full report) — owner: Karthik
> - CAIQ / SIG-lite Q&A (we'll do a focused CAIQ for the scope you need) — owner: Mina Haddad
> - SSO / SAML metadata (saml-metadata.xml) — owner: Marissa (cc'd)
> - Data retention and deletion policy (short memo) — owner: Mina

Thanks — looping back with status. I completed a scoped CAIQ (answers highlighted for items we typically mark as SAAS/non-hosted) and uploaded a draft to our shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_redwood_security (internal).

Portal activity: I accepted the OneTrust invite and started the profile. OneTrust portal ID: GL-Redwood-2027. I uploaded the following to the portal in the Evidence > Docs tab: 
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (SOC 2 summary + pointer to full report)
- data_retention_policy.md (markdown summary of retention/deletion timelines)
- saml-metadata.xml (SSO metadata file)

Outstanding items: the full SOC 2 report is available but gated; procurement asked for a proof-of-possession and a contact to coordinate NDA/release. Karthik — can you attach the short proof-of-possession note (I referenced in the portal) and share the contact for release if GreenLeaf needs the full report?

I'll also export the CAIQ CSV and attach in the portal. ETA: final CAIQ export by tomorrow morning (4/24).

Mina
Mina Haddad
Security Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: caiq_scoped_answers.csv (csv stub)

From: Maria Silva <maria.silva@greenleaflabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding for procurement — initial access

Thanks all — I can see the portal items and the CAIQ draft. GL procurement would like the proof-of-possession note for the SOC 2 summary and the SAML metadata confirmation in the next 24 hours if possible (they're gating a PO for an upcoming pilot).

Quick clarifying question: for the CAIQ answers, can you mark any compensating controls where the question is not directly applicable (we prefer brief notes rather than long text blocks)? Also, can you confirm if the saml-metadata.xml indicates IdP-initiated login is enabled (procurement's security contact asked specifically)?

If you can push the proof-of-possession and a one-line confirmation about IdP-initiated login by EOD Sunday (4/25), we'll route to procurement and update the PO timeline. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Maria Silva
Sr. Security & Vendor Risk Manager
GreenLeaf Labs

--
Attachment: procurement_deadline_note.txt (text stub)
